scope: rtthread fixed task for ds3231, bus=i2c, board=stm32f103rb; only APIs and preconditions needed by copied reference driver plus fixed task configuration.

types.bus_or_pin: RT-Thread typed device handle or fixed GPIO pin

task_binding.backend: rt-thread i2c bus device / local bsp implementation

operations.name: rt_i2c_transfer
operations.signature: rt_ssize_t rt_i2c_transfer(struct rt_i2c_bus_device *bus, struct rt_i2c_msg msgs[], rt_uint32_t num)
operations.success: returned message count equals requested count

api_contract.preconditions: Use the task_requirements fixed bus/pin, passed device handle, and caller-provided bus initialization/configuration; sample_ref application cadence is outside scope.

facts.requirement: Use the fixed RT-Thread I2C polling instance i2c1; the caller/adapter finds and passes a struct rt_i2c_bus_device * handle and uses 7-bit addressing. The platform initializes the bus.

Retain rt_i2c_transfer(bus,msgs,num) for polling transfers with multiple messages. struct rt_i2c_msg must express addr, read/write flags, len, and buf. Success requires the transferred message count to match the requested count; propagate failures.
